<?php
declare(strict_types=1);

/**
 * POST — generate weekly practice questions from enrolled classroom materials (students only).
 */

require_once dirname(__DIR__) . '/config/config.php';
require_once dirname(__DIR__) . '/includes/db.php';
require_once dirname(__DIR__) . '/includes/functions.php';
require_once dirname(__DIR__) . '/includes/student_materials_reviewer.php';
require_once dirname(__DIR__) . '/includes/wellness_ai.php';

if (session_status() === PHP_SESSION_NONE) {
    session_name(SESSION_NAME);
    session_start();
}

/**
 * @param array<string, mixed> $body
 * @never-return
 */
function smrq_emit_json(int $httpCode, array $body): void
{
    header('Content-Type: application/json; charset=utf-8');
    header('X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff');
    http_response_code($httpCode);

    echo json_encode(
        $body,
        JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE | JSON_INVALID_UTF8_SUBSTITUTE | JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR
    );
    exit;
}

function smrq_read_json_body(): ?array
{
    $raw = file_get_contents('php://input');
    if ($raw === false || $raw === '') {
        return [];
    }

    try {
        $decoded = json_decode($raw, true, 512, JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR);
    } catch (JsonException $e) {
        return null;
    }

    return is_array($decoded) ? $decoded : [];
}

function smrq_student_id(): int
{
    $studentId = isset($_SESSION['student_id']) ? (int) $_SESSION['student_id'] : 0;
    if ($studentId > 0) {
        return $studentId;
    }

    $userId = (int) ($_SESSION['user_id'] ?? 0);
    if ($userId < 1) {
        return 0;
    }

    $resolved = resolve_student_id_for_user($userId);
    if ($resolved !== null && $resolved > 0) {
        $_SESSION['student_id'] = $resolved;

        return $resolved;
    }

    return 0;
}

$method = strtoupper((string) ($_SERVER['REQUEST_METHOD'] ?? 'GET'));

if ($method === 'GET') {
    smrq_emit_json(200, [
        'ok' => true,
        'service' => 'student-materials-review-questions',
        'version' => '1.0.0',
        'ai_available' => wellness_ai_is_enabled(),
        'endpoints' => [
            [
                'method' => 'POST',
                'auth' => ['session_cookie_student'],
                'request_body' => [
                    'classroom_id' => 1,
                    'week' => 'Week 1',
                    'count' => 0,
                    'exclude' => [],
                ],
            ],
        ],
    ]);
}

if ($method !== 'POST') {
    smrq_emit_json(405, ['ok' => false, 'error' => 'Method not allowed.']);
}

if (empty($_SESSION['user_id']) || ($_SESSION['role'] ?? '') !== 'student') {
    smrq_emit_json(401, ['ok' => false, 'error' => 'Student login required.']);
}

$payload = smrq_read_json_body();
if ($payload === null) {
    smrq_emit_json(400, ['ok' => false, 'error' => 'Invalid JSON body.']);
}

$studentId = smrq_student_id();
if ($studentId < 1) {
    smrq_emit_json(403, ['ok' => false, 'error' => 'Student profile not linked to this account.']);
}

$classroomId = (int) ($payload['classroom_id'] ?? 0);
$week = trim((string) ($payload['week'] ?? ''));
$count = (int) ($payload['count'] ?? 0);
$exclude = [];
if (isset($payload['exclude']) && is_array($payload['exclude'])) {
    foreach ($payload['exclude'] as $questionText) {
        $text = trim((string) $questionText);
        if ($text !== '') {
            $exclude[] = $text;
        }
    }
}

try {
    $result = student_materials_reviewer_generate($studentId, $classroomId, $week, $count, $exclude);
    smrq_emit_json(200, $result);
} catch (Throwable $e) {
    smrq_emit_json(400, ['ok' => false, 'error' => $e->getMessage()]);
}

<?php
declare(strict_types=1);

/**
 * GET — pack enrolled classroom faculty items for offline reading (students only).
 * Optional: ?classroom_id=N to pack one class; omit to pack all enrolled classes.
 */

require_once dirname(__DIR__) . '/config/config.php';
require_once dirname(__DIR__) . '/includes/db.php';
require_once dirname(__DIR__) . '/includes/functions.php';

if (session_status() === PHP_SESSION_NONE) {
    session_name(SESSION_NAME);
    session_start();
}

/**
 * @param array<string, mixed> $body
 * @never-return
 */
function sop_emit_json(int $httpCode, array $body): void
{
    header('Content-Type: application/json; charset=utf-8');
    header('X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff');
    header('Cache-Control: private, no-store');
    http_response_code($httpCode);

    echo json_encode(
        $body,
        JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE | JSON_INVALID_UTF8_SUBSTITUTE | JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR
    );
    exit;
}

function sop_student_id(): int
{
    $studentId = isset($_SESSION['student_id']) ? (int) $_SESSION['student_id'] : 0;
    if ($studentId > 0) {
        return $studentId;
    }

    $userId = (int) ($_SESSION['user_id'] ?? 0);
    if ($userId < 1) {
        return 0;
    }

    $resolved = resolve_student_id_for_user($userId);
    if ($resolved !== null && $resolved > 0) {
        $_SESSION['student_id'] = $resolved;

        return $resolved;
    }

    return 0;
}

/**
 * @param array<int, array<string, mixed>> $items
 * @return array<int, array<string, mixed>>
 */
function sop_normalize_items(array $items, array $attachmentMap, bool $hasTopicSchedule): array
{
    $out = [];
    foreach ($items as $item) {
        $id = (int) ($item['id'] ?? 0);
        $resourceUrl = trim((string) ($item['resource_url'] ?? ''));
        $attachments = [];
        foreach ($attachmentMap[$id] ?? [] as $attachment) {
            $attachments[] = [
                'id' => (int) ($attachment['id'] ?? 0),
                'original_name' => (string) ($attachment['original_name'] ?? ''),
                'mime' => (string) ($attachment['mime'] ?? ''),
                'href' => classroom_content_attachment_href((int) ($attachment['id'] ?? 0)),
            ];
        }

        $resource = null;
        if ($resourceUrl !== '') {
            $isFile = classroom_content_is_attachment($resourceUrl);
            $resource = [
                'url' => $resourceUrl,
                'is_attachment' => $isFile,
                'label' => $isFile
                    ? classroom_content_attachment_name($resourceUrl)
                    : 'Open resource',
                'href' => classroom_content_resource_href($id, $resourceUrl),
            ];
        }

        $out[] = [
            'id' => $id,
            'content_type' => (string) ($item['content_type'] ?? 'material'),
            'title' => (string) ($item['title'] ?? ''),
            'body_html' => classroom_content_render_body((string) ($item['body'] ?? '')),
            'weeks' => $hasTopicSchedule ? (string) ($item['weeks'] ?? '') : '',
            'days_per_topic' => $hasTopicSchedule ? (string) ($item['days_per_topic'] ?? '') : '',
            'week_label' => classroom_content_week_label((string) ($item['weeks'] ?? '')),
            'resource' => $resource,
            'attachments' => $attachments,
            'created_at' => (string) ($item['created_at'] ?? ''),
        ];
    }

    return $out;
}

$method = strtoupper((string) ($_SERVER['REQUEST_METHOD'] ?? 'GET'));
if ($method !== 'GET') {
    sop_emit_json(405, ['ok' => false, 'error' => 'Method not allowed.']);
}

if (empty($_SESSION['user_id']) || (string) ($_SESSION['role'] ?? '') !== 'student') {
    sop_emit_json(401, ['ok' => false, 'error' => 'Student login required.']);
}

$studentId = sop_student_id();
if ($studentId < 1) {
    sop_emit_json(403, ['ok' => false, 'error' => 'Student profile not linked.']);
}

if (!db_table_exists('online_classrooms') || !db_table_exists('classroom_enrollments') || !db_table_exists('classroom_content')) {
    sop_emit_json(503, ['ok' => false, 'error' => 'Classroom features are not installed yet.']);
}

$classroomIdFilter = (int) ($_GET['classroom_id'] ?? 0);
$hasContentAttachments = db_table_exists('classroom_content_attachments');
$hasTopicSchedule = db_column_exists('classroom_content', 'weeks')
    && db_column_exists('classroom_content', 'days_per_topic');

$sql = 'SELECT oc.id, oc.title, oc.description, oc.status,
               c.course_code, c.course_name, f.full_name AS faculty_name,
               s.semester, s.school_year, s.day_of_week, s.start_time, s.end_time
        FROM classroom_enrollments ce
        INNER JOIN online_classrooms oc ON oc.id = ce.classroom_id
        INNER JOIN courses c ON c.id = oc.course_id
        INNER JOIN faculty f ON f.id = oc.faculty_id
        INNER JOIN schedules s ON s.id = oc.schedule_id
        WHERE ce.student_id = ?';
$params = [$studentId];
if ($classroomIdFilter > 0) {
    $sql .= ' AND oc.id = ?';
    $params[] = $classroomIdFilter;
}
$sql .= ' ORDER BY c.course_code ASC, oc.title ASC';

$st = db()->prepare($sql);
$st->execute($params);
$classrooms = $st->fetchAll() ?: [];

if ($classroomIdFilter > 0 && $classrooms === []) {
    sop_emit_json(404, ['ok' => false, 'error' => 'Classroom not found or you are not enrolled.']);
}

$pack = [];
$totalItems = 0;

foreach ($classrooms as $classroom) {
    $cid = (int) $classroom['id'];
    $cst = db()->prepare(
        'SELECT *
         FROM classroom_content
         WHERE classroom_id = ?
         ORDER BY
           CASE WHEN content_type = "announcement" THEN 0 ELSE 1 END ASC,
           created_at DESC,
           id DESC'
    );
    $cst->execute([$cid]);
    $rawItems = $cst->fetchAll() ?: [];

    $attachmentMap = [];
    if ($hasContentAttachments && $rawItems !== []) {
        $attachmentMap = classroom_content_attachment_map(array_column($rawItems, 'id'));
    }

    $items = sop_normalize_items($rawItems, $attachmentMap, $hasTopicSchedule);
    $totalItems += count($items);

    $announcements = array_values(array_filter(
        $items,
        static fn (array $row): bool => ($row['content_type'] ?? '') === 'announcement'
    ));
    $materials = array_values(array_filter(
        $items,
        static fn (array $row): bool => ($row['content_type'] ?? '') !== 'announcement'
    ));

    $pack[] = [
        'id' => $cid,
        'title' => (string) ($classroom['title'] ?? ''),
        'description' => (string) ($classroom['description'] ?? ''),
        'status' => (string) ($classroom['status'] ?? ''),
        'course_code' => (string) ($classroom['course_code'] ?? ''),
        'course_name' => (string) ($classroom['course_name'] ?? ''),
        'faculty_name' => (string) ($classroom['faculty_name'] ?? ''),
        'semester' => (string) ($classroom['semester'] ?? ''),
        'school_year' => (string) ($classroom['school_year'] ?? ''),
        'day_of_week' => (string) ($classroom['day_of_week'] ?? ''),
        'start_time' => (string) ($classroom['start_time'] ?? ''),
        'end_time' => (string) ($classroom['end_time'] ?? ''),
        'announcements' => $announcements,
        'materials' => $materials,
        'item_count' => count($items),
    ];
}

sop_emit_json(200, [
    'ok' => true,
    'saved_at' => date('c'),
    'student_id' => $studentId,
    'classroom_count' => count($pack),
    'item_count' => $totalItems,
    'classrooms' => $pack,
    'note' => 'Text posts and links are available offline. Attachment file downloads still need internet.',
]);

FILE: api/student_wellness_chat.php
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
<?php
declare(strict_types=1);

/**
 * REST endpoint: student wellness companion (non-diagnostic; crisis escalation for PH).
 *
 * GET  — service descriptor (public).
 * POST — chat completion (authenticated students only).
 */

require_once dirname(__DIR__) . '/config/config.php';
require_once dirname(__DIR__) . '/includes/wellness_chatbot.php';
require_once dirname(__DIR__) . '/includes/wellness_ai.php';
require_once dirname(__DIR__) . '/includes/wellness_engine.php';

if (session_status() === PHP_SESSION_NONE) {
    session_name(SESSION_NAME);
    session_start();
}

/**
 * @param array<string, mixed> $body
 * @never-return
 */
function wellness_api_emit_json(int $httpCode, array $body): void
{
    header('Content-Type: application/json; charset=utf-8');
    header('X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff');
    http_response_code($httpCode);

    echo json_encode(
        $body,
        JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE | JSON_INVALID_UTF8_SUBSTITUTE | JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR
    );
    exit;
}

function wellness_api_read_json_body(): ?array
{
    $raw = file_get_contents('php://input');
    if ($raw === false || $raw === '') {
        return [];
    }

    try {
        $decoded = json_decode($raw, true, 512, JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR);
    } catch (JsonException $e) {
        return null;
    }

    return is_array($decoded) ? $decoded : [];
}

function wellness_api_is_student_logged_in(): bool
{
    return !empty($_SESSION['user_id']) && ($_SESSION['role'] ?? '') === 'student';
}

/**
 * @param array<string, mixed> $payload
 *
 * @return list<array{role: string, content: string}>
 */
function wellness_api_parse_history(array $payload): array
{
    if (!isset($payload['history']) || !is_array($payload['history'])) {
        return [];
    }

    return wellness_ai_sanitize_history($payload['history']);
}

/** @never-return */
function wellness_api_handle_get(): void
{
    $base = rtrim((string) (defined('APP_BASE_URL') ? APP_BASE_URL : ''), '/');
    $openapi = $base . '/api/wellness_chatbot.openapi.yaml';
    wellness_api_emit_json(200, [
        'ok' => true,
        'service' => 'student-wellness-chat',
        'version' => '1.3.0',
        'ai_available' => wellness_ai_is_enabled(),
        'ollama_reachable' => wellness_ollama_reachable(),
        'ai_provider' => wellness_ai_provider(),
        'groq' => wellness_groq_status(),
        'setup_hint' => wellness_ai_has_cloud_key()
            ? null
            : (wellness_ai_provider() === 'groq'
                ? 'Groq: open config/config.php and paste your API key from https://console.groq.com/keys (starts with gsk_).'
                : 'Set WELLNESS_AI_API_KEY in config/config.php or install Ollama for local AI.'),
        'constraints' => [
            'Question-aware replies matched to scenario (exams, sleep, loneliness, family, etc.).',
            'Provides general coping support—not therapy, diagnosis, or emergency intervention.',
            'Responds in English or Filipino/Tagalog heuristically, or honors client `language_hint`.',
            'May return `crisis: true` plus Philippines crisis hotlines when ideation cues are matched.',
        ],
        'openapi_url' => $openapi,
        'endpoints' => [
            [
                'name' => 'chat',
                'method' => 'POST',
                'path' => $base !== '' ? ($base . '/api/student_wellness_chat.php') : '/api/student_wellness_chat.php',
                'auth' => ['session_cookie_student'],
                'request_body_example' => [
                    'message' => 'School has been draining and I barely sleep lately.',
                    'language_hint' => 'auto',
                ],
            ],
        ],
        'disclaimer_banner_en' => wellness_disclaimer_banner('en'),
        'philippines_crisis_sample' => wellness_ph_crises_resources_public(),
    ]);
}

/** @never-return */
function wellness_api_handle_post(): void
{
    if (!wellness_api_is_student_logged_in()) {
        wellness_api_emit_json(401, [
            'ok' => false,
            'error' => 'Login required.',
            'code' => 'UNAUTHORIZED',
        ]);
    }

    $payload = wellness_api_read_json_body();
    if ($payload === null) {
        wellness_api_emit_json(400, [
            'ok' => false,
            'error' => 'Invalid JSON.',
            'code' => 'BAD_JSON',
        ]);
    }

    $messageRaw = isset($payload['message']) ? (string) $payload['message'] : '';
    if (mb_strlen($messageRaw, 'UTF-8') > 4000) {
        wellness_api_emit_json(400, [
            'ok' => false,
            'error' => 'Message exceeds 4000 characters.',
            'code' => 'MESSAGE_TOO_LONG',
        ]);
    }

    $hintLc = null;
    if (isset($payload['language_hint'])) {
        $h = mb_strtolower(trim((string) $payload['language_hint']), 'UTF-8');
        $hintLc = $h !== '' ? $h : null;
    } elseif (isset($payload['locale'])) {
        $h = mb_strtolower(trim((string) $payload['locale']), 'UTF-8');
        $hintLc = $h !== '' ? $h : null;
    }
    if ($hintLc === 'auto') {
        $hintLc = null;
    }

    $history = wellness_api_parse_history($payload);
    if ($history === [] && !empty($_SESSION['wellness_chat_history']) && is_array($_SESSION['wellness_chat_history'])) {
        $history = wellness_ai_sanitize_history($_SESSION['wellness_chat_history']);
    }

    $out = wellness_chat_orchestrate($messageRaw, $hintLc, $history);

    if ($messageRaw !== '' && !$out['crisis']) {
        $_SESSION['wellness_chat_history'] = wellness_ai_sanitize_history(array_merge(
            $history,
            [
                ['role' => 'user', 'content' => $messageRaw],
                ['role' => 'assistant', 'content' => $out['reply_body']],
            ]
        ));
    }

    $reply = [
        'ok' => true,
        'reply' => $out['reply'],
        'reply_body' => $out['reply_body'],
        'reply_format' => 'markdown',
        'crisis' => $out['crisis'],
        'intent' => $out['intent'],
        'scenarios' => $out['scenarios'],
        'is_question' => $out['is_question'],
        'topics' => $out['topics'],
        'detected_language' => $out['language'],
        'disclaimer_banner' => $out['disclaimer_banner'],
        'footer_disclaimer' => $out['footer_disclaimer'],
        'philippines_crisis_resources' => $out['resources'] ?? null,
        'reply_source' => $out['reply_source'] ?? 'builtin',
    ];

    wellness_api_emit_json(200, $reply);
}

$method = $_SERVER['REQUEST_METHOD'] ?? 'GET';

if ($method === 'GET') {
    wellness_api_handle_get();
}

if ($method === 'POST') {
    wellness_api_handle_post();
}

wellness_api_emit_json(405, [
    'ok' => false,
    'error' => 'Method not allowed.',
    'code' => 'METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED',
]);

openapi: 3.0.3
info:
  title: Student Wellness Chat Companion API
  description: >
    Authenticated REST API for bounded mental-health companionship replies.
    The implementation is deterministic (rule-based)—not clinical AI—designed for
    empathetic psychoeducation within scope: stress, anxiety, loneliness,
    and low mood. It must not diagnose, prescribe, or replace therapy.
    Crisis phrasing escalates with Philippines helpline payloads.
  version: 1.1.0
  contact:
    name: Institution IT / LMS operator

servers:
  - url: http://localhost/CLASS
    description: Local XAMPP (adjust if your virtual host differs)

paths:
  /api/student_wellness_chat.php:
    get:
      summary: Service descriptor & sample crisis resources
      description: >-
        Returns non-sensitive metadata suitable for onboarding API clients or
        student developers. Philippines helpline excerpts match the deterministic
        server copy (verify externally before production).
      operationId: getWellnessChatInfo
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Capability catalog
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: object
                properties:
                  ok:
                    type: boolean
                  service:
                    type: string
                  version:
                    type: string
                  constraints:
                    type: array
                    items:
                      type: string
                  openapi_url:
                    type: string
                    format: uri
                  endpoints:
                    type: array
                    items:
                      type: object
                  disclaimer_banner_en:
                    type: string
                  philippines_crisis_sample:
                    type: object
    post:
      summary: Non-diagnostic chat reply
      operationId: postWellnessChat
      security:
        - CampusSessionStudent: []
      requestBody:
        required: false
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              type: object
              properties:
                message:
                  type: string
                  description: Plain student message up to ~4000 UTF-8 graphemes (server-enforced length).
                  maxLength: 4000
                  example: I feel drained before every exam cycle and spiral about failing.
                language_hint:
                  type: string
                  nullable: true
                  description: >
                    Prefer `tl`/`fil`/Tagalog synonyms, `en`, or omit/`auto`.
                  enum:
                    - en
                    - tl
                    - fil
                    - tagalog
                    - english
                    - auto
                    - ''
                locale:
                  type: string
                  nullable: true
                  description: Alias for `language_hint` when bilingual clients reuse generic field names.
              required: []
            examples:
              english:
                value:
                  message: I barely sleep lately and dread group work.
                  language_hint: en
              tagalog_heuristic:
                value:
                  message: Nababalisa ako at parang nabibigatan sa lahat kahit hindi naman lagi may deadline.
                  language_hint: auto
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Supportive reply packaged with clinical-scope disclaimers
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: object
                required:
                  - ok
                  - reply
                  - reply_body
                  - crisis
                  - intent
                  - scenarios
                  - is_question
                  - topics
                  - detected_language
                  - disclaimer_banner
                  - footer_disclaimer
                properties:
                  ok:
                    type: boolean
                  reply:
                    type: string
                    description: Question-specific answer (Markdown). Same as reply_body.
                  reply_body:
                    type: string
                    description: Main answer text without repeating disclaimers (show disclaimer_banner in UI separately).
                  reply_format:
                    type: string
                    enum: [markdown]
                  intent:
                    type: string
                    description: e.g. question_coping, exam_school, crisis, prompt
                  scenarios:
                    type: array
                    items:
                      type: string
                    description: Matched themes ordered by relevance (exam_school, sleep, loneliness, etc.)
                  is_question:
                    type: boolean
                  crisis:
                    type: boolean
                    description: True when suicidal ideation or self-harm crisis lexicon matched—the server substitutes hotline scaffolding.
                  topics:
                    type: array
                    items:
                      type: string
                      description: Lightweight emotional tags (stress, anxiety, loneliness, low_mood) when not in crisis escalation.
                  detected_language:
                    type: string
                    enum:
                      - en
                      - tl
                  disclaimer_banner:
                    type: string
                  footer_disclaimer:
                    type: string
                  philippines_crisis_resources:
                    type: object
                    nullable: true
                    description: Structured helpline snippets when crisis=true; mirrored for SPA rendering.
                  error:
                    type: string
        '401':
          description: Valid campus session lacking student role—or unauthenticated altogether.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: object
                properties:
                  ok:
                    type: boolean
                    example: false
                  error:
                    type: string
                  code:
                    type: string
                    example: UNAUTHORIZED
        '400':
          description: Malformed payload or excessively long transcript.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: object
                properties:
                  ok:
                    type: boolean
                    example: false
                  error:
                    type: string
                  code:
                    type: string
                    enum: [BAD_JSON, MESSAGE_TOO_LONG]
        '405':
          description: Verb other than GET/POST (server closes with deterministic JSON envelope).

components:
  securitySchemes:
    CampusSessionStudent:
      type: apiKey
      in: cookie
      name: FSS_SESSION
      description: >
        PHP session cookie issued by WPU SABLAe Portal after student login.

  --app-text-muted: #64748b;
}

body.app-shell {
  background-color: var(--app-bg);
  color: var(--app-text);
  -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
}

.app-main {
  max-width: 1280px;
}

.app-page-header {
  margin-bottom: 1.75rem;
}

.app-page-title {
  font-size: clamp(1.35rem, 1.05rem + 1.1vw, 1.85rem);
  font-weight: 650;
  letter-spacing: -0.025em;
  color: var(--app-text);
  line-height: 1.2;
  margin-bottom: 0.5rem;
}

.app-page-title .app-page-title-icon,
.app-role-icon {
  color: var(--sidebar-brand-icon-color, var(--bs-primary));
  opacity: 0.95;
}

.app-page-lead {
  font-size: 0.9375rem;
  color: var(--app-text-muted);
  max-width: 52rem;
  line-height: 1.55;
  margin-bottom: 0;
}

.app-meta-row {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 0.5rem 1rem;
  margin-top: 0.75rem;
  font-size: 0.875rem;
  color: var(--app-text-muted);
}

.app-meta-row strong {
  color: var(--app-text);
  font-weight: 600;
}

.app-chip {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.35rem;
  padding: 0.25rem 0.65rem;
  border-radius: 999px;
  font-size: 0.8125rem;
  font-weight: 500;
  background: rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.04);
  border: 1px solid var(--app-border);
  color: var(--app-text);
}

.app-alert {
  border-radius: var(--app-radius-sm);
  border: 1px solid transparent;
  box-shadow: var(--app-shadow-sm);
}

.app-card {
  background: var(--app-surface);
  border: 1px solid var(--app-border);
  border-radius: var(--app-radius);
  box-shadow: var(--app-shadow-sm);
  margin-bottom: 1.5rem;
  overflow: hidden;
}

.app-card-header {
  padding: 1rem 1.25rem;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--app-border);
  background: linear-gradient(180deg, #fafbfc 0%, #f8fafc 100%);
  font-weight: 600;
  font-size: 0.9375rem;
  color: var(--app-text);
}

.app-card-body {
  padding: 1.25rem 1.35rem;
}

@media (min-width: 768px) {
  .app-card-body {
    padding: 1.35rem 1.5rem;
  }
}

.app-table-shell {
  border-radius: var(--app-radius);
  border: 1px solid var(--app-border);
  box-shadow: var(--app-shadow-sm);
  background: var(--app-surface);
  overflow: hidden;
}

.app-table {
  margin-bottom: 0;
  vertical-align: middle;
}

.app-table thead th {
  font-size: 0.6875rem;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 0.055em;
  font-weight: 600;
  color: var(--app-text-muted);
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--app-border-strong);
  background: #f8fafc;
  white-space: nowrap;
  padding-top: 0.85rem;
  padding-bottom: 0.85rem;
}

.app-table tbody td {
  padding-top: 0.85rem;
  padding-bottom: 0.85rem;
  border-color: rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.06);
}

.app-table tbody tr:hover {
  background: rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.025);
}

.app-table .app-table-actions {
  text-align: end;
  white-space: nowrap;
}

.app-empty-state {
  text-align: center;
  padding: 2.5rem 1rem;
  color: var(--app-text-muted);
  font-size: 0.9375rem;
}

.app-form-actions {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 0.5rem;
  align-items: center;
  padding-top: 0.25rem;
}

/* Focus visibility for keyboard users */
:where(a, button, input:not([type="hidden"]), select, textarea, [tabindex]:not([tabindex="-1"])):focus-visible {
  outline: 2px solid var(--bs-primary);
  outline-offset: 2px;
}

#main-content:focus-visible {
  outline: 2px solid var(--bs-primary);
  outline-offset: 4px;
}

/* Navbar on light background */
.navbar-light .navbar-brand:focus-visible {
  outline-offset: 4px;
}

.app-dropdown-menu .dropdown-item:hover,
.app-dropdown-menu .dropdown-item:focus {
  background: rgba(13, 110, 253, 0.09);
}

/* Faculty schedule: stacked cells on small screens */
.app-schedule-card .table td {
  vertical-align: top;
}

@media (max-width: 991.98px) {
  .app-schedule-card .table thead {
    display: none;
  }
  .app-schedule-card .table tbody tr {
    display: block;
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--app-border);
    padding: 1rem 0;
  }
  .app-schedule-card .table tbody td {
    display: block;
    border: 0;
    padding: 0.35rem 1rem;
  }
  .app-schedule-card .table tbody td::before {
    content: attr(data-label);
    display: block;
    font-size: 0.65rem;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    letter-spacing: 0.06em;
    font-weight: 600;
    color: var(--app-text-muted);
    margin-bottom: 0.25rem;
  }
}

/* Join code highlight (faculty classroom) */
.fc-join-code-pill {
  font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, monospace;
  font-size: 1.35rem;
  font-weight: 600;
  letter-spacing: 0.04em;
  padding: 0.5rem 1rem;
  border-radius: var(--app-radius-sm);
  background: #f1f5f9;
  border: 1px solid var(--app-border);
  color: var(--app-text);
}

/* Week content cards */
.fc-content-item-card {
  border-radius: var(--app-radius-sm) !important;
  border: 1px solid var(--app-border) !important;
  box-shadow: var(--app-shadow-sm) !important;
  background: var(--app-surface) !important;
}

.fc-week-link.is-active-week {
  border-color: rgba(13, 110, 253, 0.45) !important;
  background: rgba(13, 110, 253, 0.06) !important;
}

.schedule-cell {
  min-height: 3rem;
  font-size: 0.85rem;
}
.schedule-block {
  border-radius: 0.35rem;
  padding: 0.35rem 0.5rem;
  margin-bottom: 0.25rem;
  border-left: 4px solid rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.15);
}
.schedule-block.c0 { background: #e3f2fd; border-left-color: #1976d2; }
.schedule-block.c1 { background: #e8f5e9; border-left-color: #388e3c; }
.schedule-block.c2 { background: #fff3e0; border-left-color: #f57c00; }
.schedule-block.c3 { background: #fce4ec; border-left-color: #c2185b; }
.schedule-block.c4 { background: #f3e5f5; border-left-color: #7b1fa2; }
.schedule-block.c5 { background: #e0f7fa; border-left-color: #00838f; }

/* Faculty course color picker (view_schedule.php) */
.course-color-panel {
  background: var(--app-surface, #fff);
}
.course-color-preview {
  display: inline-block;
  width: 1.25rem;
  height: 1.25rem;
  flex-shrink: 0;
  border-radius: 0.3rem;
  border: 2px solid var(--swatch-border, #94a3b8);
  background: var(--swatch-bg, #e2e8f0);
}
.course-color-preview--sm {
  width: 0.9rem;
  height: 0.9rem;
}
.course-color-legend-item {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.35rem;
  padding: 0.2rem 0.55rem;
  border-radius: 999px;
  background: rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.04);
}

html[data-bs-theme="dark"] .course-color-panel {
  background: var(--bs-body-bg);
}
html[data-bs-theme="dark"] .course-color-legend-item {
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.06);
}

/* Timed weekly grid: left time axis + vacant slots */
.schedule-weekly--timed .schedule-time-col {
  width: 4.75rem;
  min-width: 4.75rem;
  max-width: 5.5rem;
  white-space: nowrap;
  vertical-align: top;
  background: #f8fafc;
  position: sticky;
  left: 0;
  z-index: 2;
}
.schedule-weekly--timed thead .schedule-time-col {
  z-index: 3;
}
.schedule-weekly--timed .schedule-time-label {
  font-size: 0.8rem;
  line-height: 1.2;
}
.schedule-weekly--timed .schedule-time-end {
  font-size: 0.7rem;
  line-height: 1.2;
}
.schedule-weekly--timed tbody tr {
  min-height: 4.5rem;
}
.schedule-weekly--timed .schedule-cell {
  min-height: 4.5rem;
  height: 1%;
}
.schedule-weekly--timed .schedule-cell--vacant {
  background: repeating-linear-gradient(
    -45deg,
    transparent,
    transparent 6px,
    rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.03) 6px,
    rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.03) 12px
  );
}
.schedule-weekly--timed .schedule-vacant-label {
  display: block;
  font-size: 0.7rem;
  color: #94a3b8;
  letter-spacing: 0.02em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
}
.schedule-weekly--timed .schedule-block--continued {
  opacity: 0.85;
  border-left-style: dashed;
  padding-top: 0.25rem;
  padding-bottom: 0.25rem;
}
.schedule-weekly--timed .schedule-cell--spanned {
  vertical-align: top;
}
.schedule-weekly--timed .schedule-block--spanned {
  min-height: calc(var(--block-span, 1) * 4.25rem - 0.5rem);
  height: calc(100% - 0.25rem);
  box-sizing: border-box;
}

/* Weekly schedule grid (view_schedule.php) — dark mode contrast */
html[data-bs-theme="dark"] .schedule-weekly {
  color: var(--bs-body-color);
  --sw-cell-border: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.12);
}

html[data-bs-theme="dark"] .schedule-weekly > :not(caption) > * > * {
  border-color: var(--sw-cell-border);
}

html[data-bs-theme="dark"] .schedule-weekly thead.table-primary th {
  background: linear-gradient(180deg, #1e3a5f 0%, #152a45 100%);
  color: #e2e8f0;
  border-color: var(--sw-cell-border);
}

html[data-bs-theme="dark"] .schedule-weekly tbody td {
  background-color: var(--bs-body-bg);
  color: var(--bs-body-color);
}

html[data-bs-theme="dark"] .schedule-weekly--timed .schedule-time-col {
  background: #152a45;
  color: #e2e8f0;
}

html[data-bs-theme="dark"] .schedule-weekly--timed .schedule-cell--vacant {
  background: repeating-linear-gradient(
    -45deg,
    transparent,
    transparent 6px,
    rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.04) 6px,
    rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.04) 12px
  );
}

html[data-bs-theme="dark"] .schedule-weekly--timed .schedule-vacant-label {
  color: rgba(241, 245, 249, 0.45);
}

html[data-bs-theme="dark"] .schedule-cell {
  color: var(--bs-body-color);
}

html[data-bs-theme="dark"] .schedule-block {
  color: #f1f5f9;
  border-left-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.35);
}

html[data-bs-theme="dark"] .schedule-block .text-muted {
  color: rgba(241, 245, 249, 0.78) !important;
}

html[data-bs-theme="dark"] .schedule-block .border-top.border-secondary-subtle,
html[data-bs-theme="dark"] .schedule-block .border-secondary-subtle {
  border-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.18) !important;
}

html[data-bs-theme="dark"] .schedule-block.c0 {
  background: rgba(25, 118, 210, 0.32);
  border-left-color: #60a5fa;
}

html[data-bs-theme="dark"] .schedule-block.c1 {
  background: rgba(46, 125, 50, 0.32);
  border-left-color: #4ade80;
}

html[data-bs-theme="dark"] .schedule-block.c2 {
  background: rgba(230, 81, 0, 0.28);
  border-left-color: #fb923c;
}

html[data-bs-theme="dark"] .schedule-block.c3 {
  background: rgba(173, 20, 87, 0.3);
  border-left-color: #f472b6;
}

html[data-bs-theme="dark"] .schedule-block.c4 {
  background: rgba(106, 27, 154, 0.3);
  border-left-color: #c084fc;
}

html[data-bs-theme="dark"] .schedule-block.c5 {
  background: rgba(0, 131, 143, 0.3);
  border-left-color: #2dd4bf;
}

.stat-card {
  border: none;
  border-radius: 0.5rem;
  box-shadow: 0 0.125rem 0.25rem rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.075);
}

/* Responsive navbar/menu typography */
.navbar .navbar-brand {
  font-size: clamp(1rem, 0.9rem + 0.45vw, 1.25rem);
}

.navbar .nav-link {
  font-size: clamp(0.85rem, 0.8rem + 0.2vw, 1rem);
}

.navbar .navbar-text {
  font-size: clamp(0.75rem, 0.7rem + 0.2vw, 0.9rem);
}

/* Responsive, polished dropdown component */
.app-dropdown-menu .dropdown-toggle {
  border-radius: 999px;
  padding: 0.35rem 0.75rem;
}

.app-dropdown-menu .dropdown-menu {
  min-width: 260px;
  border-radius: 0.85rem;
  overflow: hidden;
  margin-top: 0.45rem;
}

.app-dropdown-menu .dropdown-item {
  padding: 0.55rem 0.95rem;
  font-size: 0.95rem;
}

.app-dropdown-menu .dropdown-item:hover,
.app-dropdown-menu .dropdown-item:focus {
  background: rgba(13, 110, 253, 0.08);
}

@media (max-width: 991.98px) {
  .app-dropdown-menu {
    width: 100%;
    margin-top: 0.5rem;
  }
  .app-dropdown-menu .dropdown-toggle {
    width: 100%;
    justify-content: center;
  }
  .app-dropdown-menu .dropdown-menu {
    width: 100%;
    min-width: 100%;
  }
}

.report-hub .card-header strong {
  letter-spacing: 0.2px;
}

.report-hub .list-group-item {
  font-size: 0.92rem;
}

.report-hub .list-group-item .btn {
  border-radius: 999px;
}

@keyframes livePulse {
  0%,
  100% {
    box-shadow: 0 0 0 0 rgba(220, 53, 69, 0.55);
  }
  50% {
    box-shadow: 0 0 0 6px rgba(220, 53, 69, 0);
  }
}

.live-pulse-badge {
  animation: livePulse 1.6s ease-in-out infinite;
}

.wordpad-shell {
  border: 1px solid var(--bs-border-color);
  border-radius: 0.5rem;
  background: #fff;
  overflow: hidden;
}

.wordpad-toolbar {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 0.4rem;
  padding: 0.5rem;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--bs-border-color);
  background: #f8f9fa;
}

.wordpad-toolbar .btn {
  min-width: 2.2rem;
}

.wordpad-select {
  width: auto;
  min-width: 9rem;
}

.wordpad-select--font {
  min-width: 8.5rem;
}

.wordpad-select--size {
  min-width: 7.5rem;
}

.wordpad-editor {
  min-height: 10rem;
  padding: 0.75rem;
  border: 0;
  border-radius: 0;
  box-shadow: none;
  overflow-y: auto;
}

.wordpad-editor:focus {
  outline: none;
  box-shadow: none;
}

.wordpad-editor:empty::before {
  content: attr(data-placeholder);
  color: #6c757d;
}

.classroom-content-body {
  line-height: 1.5;
}

.classroom-content-body p,
.classroom-content-body ul,
.classroom-content-body ol,
.classroom-content-body blockquote,
.classroom-content-body h2,
.classroom-content-body h3 {
  margin-bottom: 0.5rem;
}

.classroom-content-body p:last-child,
.classroom-content-body ul:last-child,
.classroom-content-body ol:last-child,
.classroom-content-body blockquote:last-child,
.classroom-content-body h2:last-child,
.classroom-content-body h3:last-child {
  margin-bottom: 0;
}

.classroom-content-body ul,
.classroom-content-body ol {
  padding-left: 1.25rem;
}

.classroom-content-body blockquote {
  padding-left: 0.75rem;
  border-left: 3px solid rgba(13, 110, 253, 0.25);
  color: #495057;
}

.classroom-content-body a {
  word-break: break-word;
}

.classroom-content-body img,
.classroom-content-attachment-image img,
.wordpad-editor img {
  max-width: 100%;
  height: auto;
  display: block;
  margin: 0.75rem 0;
  border-radius: 0.4rem;
}

.classroom-content-attachment-image {
  max-width: 40rem;
}

@media print {
  .no-print { display: none !important; }
}

/* Faculty online classroom — management UI (scoped under .fc-manage) */
.fc-manage {
  --fc-accent: #1a73e8;
  --fc-accent-soft: rgba(26, 115, 232, 0.08);
  --fc-card-radius: 12px;
}

.fc-manage .fc-section-card {
  border: 0;
  border-radius: var(--fc-card-radius);
  box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(60, 64, 67, 0.12), 0 1px 4px rgba(60, 64, 67, 0.08);
}

.fc-manage .fc-section-card .card-header {
  background: #fff;
  border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.06);
  padding: 1rem 1.25rem;
  border-radius: var(--fc-card-radius) var(--fc-card-radius) 0 0 !important;
}

.fc-manage .fc-section-title {
  font-size: 0.9375rem;
  font-weight: 600;
  letter-spacing: 0.02em;
  color: #3c4043;
  margin: 0;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.5rem;
}

.fc-manage .fc-section-title i {
  color: var(--fc-accent);
  width: 1.25rem;
  text-align: center;
}

.fc-manage .fc-subsection {
  margin-bottom: 1.5rem;
}

.fc-manage .fc-subsection:last-child {
  margin-bottom: 0;
}

.fc-manage .fc-subsection-label {
  font-size: 0.8125rem;
  font-weight: 600;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 0.04em;
  color: #5f6368;
  margin-bottom: 0.75rem;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.35rem;
}

.fc-manage .fc-subsection-label i {
  opacity: 0.85;
  font-size: 0.9rem;
}

.fc-manage .fc-inner-panel {
  background: #f8f9fa;
  border-radius: 10px;
  padding: 1rem 1.125rem;
  border: 1px solid rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.06);
}

.fc-manage .fc-page-title {
  font-size: 1.5rem;
  font-weight: 600;
  color: #202124;
  letter-spacing: -0.02em;
}

.fc-manage .fc-meta-line {
  color: #5f6368;
  font-size: 0.875rem;
}

.fc-manage .fc-btn-primary-lg {
  font-weight: 600;
  padding: 0.5rem 1.5rem;
  border-radius: 999px;
  box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(26, 115, 232, 0.35);
}

.fc-manage .fc-stat-tile {
  border-radius: 10px;
  border: 1px solid rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.06);
  background: #fff;
  padding: 1rem 1.125rem;
  height: 100%;
  transition: box-shadow 0.15s ease;
}

.fc-manage .fc-stat-tile:hover {
  box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(60, 64, 67, 0.1);
}

.fc-manage .fc-stat-tile .fc-stat-icon {
  width: 2.25rem;
  height: 2.25rem;
  border-radius: 8px;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  background: var(--fc-accent-soft);
  color: var(--fc-accent);
  margin-bottom: 0.5rem;
}

.fc-manage .fc-stat-value {
  font-size: 1.5rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: #202124;
  line-height: 1.2;
}

.fc-manage .fc-stat-label {
  font-size: 0.75rem;
  font-weight: 600;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 0.05em;
  color: #5f6368;
}

.fc-manage .fc-roster-empty,
.fc-manage .fc-placeholder-hint {
  color: #80868b;
  font-size: 0.875rem;
}

.fc-manage .table.fc-roster-table thead th {
  font-size: 0.6875rem;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 0.06em;
  font-weight: 600;
  color: #5f6368;
  border-bottom-width: 1px;
}

.fc-manage .fc-week-link {
  border-radius: 8px;
  border: 1px solid rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.08);
  margin-bottom: 0.5rem;
  padding: 0.75rem 1rem;
  text-decoration: none;
  color: inherit;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  background: #fff;
  transition: background 0.12s ease, border-color 0.12s ease;
}

.fc-manage .fc-week-link:hover {
  background: #f8f9fa;
  border-color: rgba(26, 115, 232, 0.25);
  color: inherit;
}

body.page-fc-week-edit-popup .admin-sidebar,
body.page-fc-week-edit-popup .admin-topbar,
body.page-fc-week-edit-popup .visually-hidden-focusable {
  display: none !important;
}

body.page-fc-week-edit-popup .admin-layout {
  min-height: auto;
}

body.page-fc-week-edit-popup #main-content {
  max-width: 100%;
}

/* —— App shell: sidebar, grouped nav, top bar (admin + all roles) —— */
body.app-shell-sidebar,
body.app-admin-shell {
  --admin-sidebar-w: 272px;
  --admin-sidebar-bg: linear-gradient(180deg, #f8fafc 0%, #f1f5f9 100%);
  --admin-sidebar-border: rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.08);
  --sidebar-brand-icon-bg: rgba(37, 99, 235, 0.12);
  --sidebar-brand-icon-color: #2563eb;
  --admin-nav-icon: #5b8def;
  --admin-nav-icon-active: var(--sidebar-brand-icon-color);
  --admin-nav-link-hover-bg: rgba(37, 99, 235, 0.09);
  --admin-nav-link-active-bg: rgba(37, 99, 235, 0.14);
  --admin-nav-link-active-text: var(--sidebar-brand-icon-color);
}

body.app-shell-sidebar--super_admin {
  --sidebar-brand-icon-bg: rgba(225, 29, 72, 0.12);
  --sidebar-brand-icon-color: #e11d48;
  --admin-nav-icon: #f43f5e;
  --admin-nav-link-hover-bg: rgba(225, 29, 72, 0.09);
  --admin-nav-link-active-bg: rgba(225, 29, 72, 0.14);
}
body.app-shell-sidebar--admin {
  --sidebar-brand-icon-bg: rgba(37, 99, 235, 0.13);
  --sidebar-brand-icon-color: #2563eb;
  --admin-nav-icon: #5b8def;
  --admin-nav-link-hover-bg: rgba(37, 99, 235, 0.09);
  --admin-nav-link-active-bg: rgba(37, 99, 235, 0.14);
}
body.app-shell-sidebar--dean {
  --sidebar-brand-icon-bg: rgba(67, 56, 202, 0.13);
  --sidebar-brand-icon-color: #4338ca;
  --admin-nav-icon: #6366f1;
  --admin-nav-link-hover-bg: rgba(67, 56, 202, 0.09);
  --admin-nav-link-active-bg: rgba(67, 56, 202, 0.14);
}
body.app-shell-sidebar--program_chair {
  --sidebar-brand-icon-bg: rgba(109, 40, 217, 0.12);
  --sidebar-brand-icon-color: #6d28d9;
  --admin-nav-icon: #8b5cf6;
  --admin-nav-link-hover-bg: rgba(109, 40, 217, 0.09);
  --admin-nav-link-active-bg: rgba(109, 40, 217, 0.14);
}
body.app-shell-sidebar--gened {
  --sidebar-brand-icon-bg: rgba(4, 120, 87, 0.12);
  --sidebar-brand-icon-color: #047857;
  --admin-nav-icon: #10b981;
  --admin-nav-link-hover-bg: rgba(4, 120, 87, 0.09);
  --admin-nav-link-active-bg: rgba(4, 120, 87, 0.14);
}
body.app-shell-sidebar--faculty {
  --sidebar-brand-icon-bg: rgba(194, 65, 12, 0.12);
  --sidebar-brand-icon-color: #c2410c;
  --admin-nav-icon: #ea580c;
  --admin-nav-link-hover-bg: rgba(194, 65, 12, 0.09);
  --admin-nav-link-active-bg: rgba(194, 65, 12, 0.14);
}
body.app-shell-sidebar--student {
  --sidebar-brand-icon-bg: rgba(2, 132, 199, 0.12);
  --sidebar-brand-icon-color: #0284c7;
  --admin-nav-icon: #0ea5e9;
  --admin-nav-link-hover-bg: rgba(2, 132, 199, 0.09);
  --admin-nav-link-active-bg: rgba(2, 132, 199, 0.14);
}

.admin-layout {
  background: var(--app-bg);
}

.admin-sidebar {
  width: var(--admin-sidebar-w);
  min-height: 100vh;
  height: 100vh;
  position: sticky;
  top: 0;
  align-self: flex-start;
  background: var(--admin-sidebar-bg);
  border-right: 1px solid var(--admin-sidebar-border);
  box-shadow: 2px 0 24px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.04);
}

.admin-sidebar-brand {
  padding: 1.25rem 1.1rem 1rem;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--admin-sidebar-border);
}

.admin-sidebar-brand-link {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.65rem;
  text-decoration: none;
  color: var(--app-text);
  font-weight: 650;
  font-size: 1.02rem;
  letter-spacing: -0.02em;
  line-height: 1.25;
}

.admin-sidebar-brand-link:hover {
  color: var(--sidebar-brand-icon-color, var(--bs-primary));
}

.admin-sidebar-brand-icon {
  width: 2.25rem;
  height: 2.25rem;
  border-radius: 12px;
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  background: transparent;
  font-size: 1.05rem;
  flex-shrink: 0;
  overflow: hidden;
}

.admin-sidebar-brand-meta {
  margin-top: 0.35rem;
  margin-left: 2.9rem;
  font-size: 0.7rem;
  font-weight: 600;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 0.08em;
  color: var(--app-text-muted);
}

.admin-sidebar-nav {
  padding: 0.85rem 0.65rem 1rem;
  overflow-y: auto;
  min-height: 0;
}

.admin-nav-section + .admin-nav-section {
  margin-top: 1.15rem;
}

.admin-nav-section-label {
  font-size: 0.65rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 0.09em;
  color: var(--app-text-muted);
  padding: 0.35rem 0.65rem 0.5rem;
}

.admin-nav-list li + li {
  margin-top: 0.15rem;
}

.admin-nav-link {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.55rem;
  padding: 0.45rem 0.65rem;
  border-radius: 10px;
  text-decoration: none;
  color: var(--app-text);
  font-size: 0.9rem;
  font-weight: 500;
  transition: background 0.12s ease, color 0.12s ease;
}

.admin-nav-link:hover {
  background: var(--admin-nav-link-hover-bg, rgba(37, 99, 235, 0.09));
  color: var(--app-text);
}

.admin-nav-link.active {
  background: var(--admin-nav-link-active-bg, rgba(37, 99, 235, 0.14));
  color: var(--admin-nav-link-active-text, var(--sidebar-brand-icon-color, var(--bs-primary)));
  font-weight: 600;
}

.admin-nav-icon {
  width: 1.35rem;
  text-align: center;
  flex-shrink: 0;
  color: var(--admin-nav-icon);
  font-size: 0.95rem;
  transition: color 0.12s ease;
}

.admin-nav-link:hover .admin-nav-icon,
.admin-nav-link.active .admin-nav-icon {
  color: var(--admin-nav-icon-active, var(--sidebar-brand-icon-color, var(--bs-primary)));
}

.admin-nav-text {
  flex: 1 1 auto;
  min-width: 0;
}

.admin-nav-badge {
  font-size: 0.65rem;
  padding: 0.2em 0.45em;
}

.admin-sidebar-footer {
  margin-top: auto;
  padding: 0.85rem 1rem 1.1rem;
  border-top: 1px solid var(--admin-sidebar-border);
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.5);
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 0.25rem;
}

.admin-sidebar-foot-link {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  padding: 0.45rem 0.65rem;
  border-radius: 10px;
  font-size: 0.88rem;
  font-weight: 500;
  text-decoration: none;
  color: var(--app-text-muted);
  transition: background 0.12s ease, color 0.12s ease;
}

.admin-sidebar-foot-link:not(.admin-sidebar-logout) i {
  color: var(--admin-nav-icon);
}

.admin-sidebar-foot-link:hover {
  background: rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.05);
  color: var(--app-text);
}

.admin-sidebar-logout {
  color: #b91c1c;
}

.admin-sidebar-logout:hover {
  background: rgba(185, 28, 28, 0.08);
  color: #991b1b;
}

.admin-offcanvas-nav {
  position: fixed;
  top: 0;
  left: 0;
  bottom: 0;
  height: 100%;
  width: min(320px, 92vw);
  max-width: 100%;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  background: var(--admin-sidebar-bg, var(--app-surface, #fff));
  border-right: 1px solid var(--admin-sidebar-border, rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.08));
  box-shadow: 2px 0 24px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.18);
  z-index: 1060;
  transform: translateX(-100%);
  transition: transform 0.3s ease;
  will-change: transform;
  overflow: hidden;
}

.admin-offcanvas-nav.show,
#adminNavToggle:checked ~ .admin-offcanvas-nav {
  transform: none;
}

.admin-nav-toggle-input {
  position: fixed;
  top: 0;
  left: -9999px;
  width: 1px;
  height: 1px;
  opacity: 0;
  pointer-events: none;
}

@media (min-width: 992px) {
  .admin-offcanvas-nav,
  .admin-offcanvas-backdrop,
  .admin-nav-toggle-input {
    display: none;
  }
}

.admin-offcanvas-backdrop {
  position: fixed;
  inset: 0;
  z-index: 1055;
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0;
  border: 0;
  background: rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.5);
  opacity: 0;
  pointer-events: none;
  transition: opacity 0.3s ease;
}

.admin-offcanvas-backdrop.show,
#adminNavToggle:checked ~ .admin-offcanvas-backdrop {
  opacity: 1;
  pointer-events: auto;
}

.admin-offcanvas-nav .offcanvas-header {
  padding: 1rem 1.1rem;
}

.admin-offcanvas-nav .offcanvas-body {
  flex: 1 1 auto;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  min-height: 0;
  overflow: hidden;
  padding: 0;
}

.admin-offcanvas-nav .admin-sidebar-nav {
  flex: 1 1 auto;
  min-height: 0;
  overflow-x: hidden;
  overflow-y: auto;
  -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch;
  overscroll-behavior: contain;
}

.admin-topbar {
  position: sticky;
  top: 0;
  z-index: 1040;
}

.admin-main-wrap {
  background: var(--app-bg);
}

.admin-topbar-title {
  font-size: clamp(1rem, 0.92rem + 0.35vw, 1.2rem);
  font-weight: 650;
  letter-spacing: -0.02em;
  color: var(--app-text);
  line-height: 1.25;
}

.admin-topbar-subtitle {
  letter-spacing: 0.02em;
}

.admin-topbar-avatar {
  width: 2.1rem;
  height: 2.1rem;
  background: var(--sidebar-brand-icon-bg, rgba(37, 99, 235, 0.12));
  color: var(--sidebar-brand-icon-color, var(--bs-primary));
  font-size: 0.95rem;
  border: 1.5px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--sidebar-brand-icon-color, var(--bs-primary)) 22%, transparent);
  box-shadow: 0 1px 4px color-mix(in srgb, var(--sidebar-brand-icon-color, var(--bs-primary)) 14%, transparent);
}

.admin-topbar-avatar-icon {
  color: var(--sidebar-brand-icon-color, var(--bs-primary));
}

.admin-topbar-avatar-img {
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  object-fit: cover;
  display: block;
}

.settings-profile-preview {
  width: 5rem;
  height: 5rem;
  object-fit: cover;
}

.admin-topbar-user .dropdown-item {
  font-size: 0.9rem;
  padding: 0.45rem 0.85rem;
}

@media (min-width: 992px) {
  .admin-main-wrap > main.app-main {
    margin-left: auto;
    margin-right: auto;
  }
}

/* Contextual tooltips (cursor-follow; see assets/js/app_tooltips.js) */
.app-cursor-tooltip {
  position: fixed;
  z-index: 1090;
  max-width: 220px;
  padding: 0.5rem 0.75rem;
  border-radius: 8px;
  font-size: 0.8125rem;
  line-height: 1.38;
  pointer-events: none;
  box-shadow: 0 4px 16px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.12);
  border: 1px solid #f59e0b;
  background: #fffbeb;
  color: #92400e;
  opacity: 0;
  transition: opacity 0.25s ease;
}

.app-cursor-tooltip[aria-hidden="false"] {
  opacity: 1;
}

html[data-bs-theme="dark"] body.app-shell .app-cursor-tooltip {
  background: #451a03;
  color: #fde68a;
  border-color: #d97706;
  box-shadow: 0 8px 28px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.45);
}

/* —— Global dark/light (top bar toggle; Bootstrap data-bs-theme on <html>) —— */
.app-theme-toggle {
  border-radius: 999px;
  padding: 0.35rem 0.85rem;
  font-size: 0.8rem;
  font-weight: 500;
  border: 1px solid var(--bs-border-color);
  background: var(--bs-body-bg);
  color: var(--bs-body-color);
  transition: background 0.15s ease, border-color 0.15s ease, color 0.15s ease;
}

.app-theme-toggle:hover {
  background: var(--bs-secondary-bg);
  border-color: var(--bs-secondary-border-subtle);
  color: var(--bs-body-color);
}

html[data-bs-theme="dark"] {
  color-scheme: dark;
  --app-bg: #0f1419;
  --app-surface: #151b24;
  --app-border: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
  --app-border-strong: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.12);
  --app-shadow-sm: 0 1px 2px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4);
  --app-shadow-md: 0 8px 24px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.35);
  --app-text: #e2e8f0;
  --app-text-muted: #94a3b8;
}

html[data-bs-theme="dark"] body.app-shell-sidebar,
html[data-bs-theme="dark"] body.app-admin-shell {
  --admin-sidebar-bg: linear-gradient(180deg, #101722 0%, #0c1018 100%);
  --admin-sidebar-border: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
}

html[data-bs-theme="dark"] body.app-shell-sidebar--super_admin {
  --sidebar-brand-icon-bg: rgba(244, 63, 94, 0.18);
  --sidebar-brand-icon-color: #fb7185;
  --admin-nav-icon: #fda4af;
}
html[data-bs-theme="dark"] body.app-shell-sidebar--admin {
  --sidebar-brand-icon-bg: rgba(96, 165, 250, 0.16);
  --sidebar-brand-icon-color: #60a5fa;
  --admin-nav-icon: #93c5fd;
}
html[data-bs-theme="dark"] body.app-shell-sidebar--dean {
  --sidebar-brand-icon-bg: rgba(129, 140, 248, 0.16);
  --sidebar-brand-icon-color: #818cf8;
  --admin-nav-icon: #a5b4fc;
}
html[data-bs-theme="dark"] body.app-shell-sidebar--program_chair {
  --sidebar-brand-icon-bg: rgba(167, 139, 250, 0.16);
  --sidebar-brand-icon-color: #a78bfa;
  --admin-nav-icon: #c4b5fd;
}
html[data-bs-theme="dark"] body.app-shell-sidebar--gened {
  --sidebar-brand-icon-bg: rgba(52, 211, 153, 0.14);
  --sidebar-brand-icon-color: #34d399;
  --admin-nav-icon: #6ee7b7;
}
html[data-bs-theme="dark"] body.app-shell-sidebar--faculty {
  --sidebar-brand-icon-bg: rgba(251, 146, 60, 0.16);
  --sidebar-brand-icon-color: #fb923c;
  --admin-nav-icon: #fdba74;
}
html[data-bs-theme="dark"] body.app-shell-sidebar--student {
  --sidebar-brand-icon-bg: rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.16);
  --sidebar-brand-icon-color: #38bdf8;
  --admin-nav-icon: #7dd3fc;
}

html[data-bs-theme="dark"] .admin-sidebar {
  box-shadow: 2px 0 24px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.35);
}

html[data-bs-theme="dark"] .admin-sidebar-footer {
  background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.25);
}

html[data-bs-theme="dark"] .admin-nav-link:hover {
  background: var(--admin-nav-link-hover-bg, rgba(96, 165, 250, 0.14));
}

html[data-bs-theme="dark"] .admin-nav-link.active {
  background: var(--admin-nav-link-active-bg, rgba(96, 165, 250, 0.22));
}

html[data-bs-theme="dark"] .admin-sidebar-foot-link:hover {
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.06);
}

html[data-bs-theme="dark"] .app-card-header {
  background: linear-gradient(180deg, #1a2230 0%, #151b24 100%);
}

html[data-bs-theme="dark"] .app-chip {
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.06);
  border-color: var(--app-border);
}

html[data-bs-theme="dark"] .app-table thead th {
  background: #1e293b;
  color: var(--app-text-muted);
}

/* —— Dark mode: contrast (avoid washed / wrong text vs background) —— */
html[data-bs-theme="dark"] body.app-shell {
  background-color: var(--app-bg);
  color: var(--app-text);
}

html[data-bs-theme="dark"] .text-muted {
  color: var(--bs-secondary-color) !important;
}

/* Utility surfaces that stay “paper white” in markup */
html[data-bs-theme="dark"] .bg-white,
html[data-bs-theme="dark"] .card-header.bg-white,
html[data-bs-theme="dark"] .card-footer.bg-white {
  background-color: var(--bs-tertiary-bg) !important;
  color: var(--bs-body-color) !important;
  border-color: var(--bs-border-color);
}

html[data-bs-theme="dark"] .bg-light {
  background-color: var(--bs-secondary-bg) !important;
  color: var(--bs-body-color) !important;
}

html[data-bs-theme="dark"] .text-dark {
  color: var(--bs-emphasis-color) !important;
}

html[data-bs-theme="dark"] .bg-warning.text-dark,
html[data-bs-theme="dark"] .badge.bg-warning.text-dark,
html[data-bs-theme="dark"] .alert-warning .text-dark {
  color: #0f172a !important;
}

html[data-bs-theme="dark"] .card:not([class*="bg-"]):not(.dashboard-hero):not(.glass-card) {
  background-color: var(--bs-body-bg);
  color: var(--bs-body-color);
  border-color: var(--bs-border-color-translucent);
}

html[data-bs-theme="dark"] .card-header:not(.bg-primary):not(.bg-success):not(.bg-danger):not(.bg-warning):not(.bg-info):not(.bg-dark) {
  color: var(--bs-body-color);
}

html[data-bs-theme="dark"] .list-group-item {
  background-color: var(--bs-body-bg);
  color: var(--bs-body-color);
  border-color: var(--bs-border-color);
}

html[data-bs-theme="dark"] .table {
  --bs-table-bg: var(--bs-body-bg);
  --bs-table-color: var(--bs-body-color);
  --bs-table-border-color: var(--bs-border-color);
  color: var(--bs-body-color);
}

html[data-bs-theme="dark"] .table > :not(caption) > * > * {
  border-bottom-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
}

html[data-bs-theme="dark"] .table-striped > tbody > tr:nth-of-type(odd) > * {
  --bs-table-accent-bg: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.04);
  color: var(--bs-body-color);
}

html[data-bs-theme="dark"] .table-hover > tbody > tr:hover > * {
  --bs-table-accent-bg: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.07);
  color: var(--bs-body-color);
}

html[data-bs-theme="dark"] .table thead th {
  background-color: var(--bs-tertiary-bg);
  color: var(--bs-secondary-color);
}

html[data-bs-theme="dark"] .border,
html[data-bs-theme="dark"] .border-secondary {
  border-color: var(--bs-border-color) !important;
}

html[data-bs-theme="dark"] .border-light {
  border-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.12) !important;
}

html[data-bs-theme="dark"] .shadow,
html[data-bs-theme="dark"] .shadow-sm {
  box-shadow: var(--app-shadow-sm) !important;
}

/* Dashboard (inline styles assume light chrome) */
html[data-bs-theme="dark"] .dashboard-shell .glass-card {
  border-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
  box-shadow: 0 16px 36px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.35);
}

html[data-bs-theme="dark"] .dashboard-shell .glass-card .card-header {
  background: linear-gradient(180deg, #1a2230 0%, #151b24 100%);
  border-bottom-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
  color: var(--app-text);
}

html[data-bs-theme="dark"] .dashboard-shell .glass-card .card-body {
  background-color: var(--bs-body-bg);
  color: var(--bs-body-color);
}

html[data-bs-theme="dark"] .dashboard-shell .upcoming-table thead th {
  background: var(--bs-tertiary-bg);
  color: var(--bs-secondary-color);
  border-color: var(--bs-border-color);
}

html[data-bs-theme="dark"] .dashboard-shell .upcoming-table tbody tr:hover {
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05);
}

html[data-bs-theme="dark"] .dashboard-shell .conflict-card .card-header {
  background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(251, 191, 36, 0.18) 0%, rgba(30, 41, 59, 0.95) 100%);
  border-bottom-color: rgba(251, 191, 36, 0.25);
  color: var(--app-text);
}

html[data-bs-theme="dark"] .dashboard-shell .conflict-card .card-body {
  background-color: var(--bs-body-bg);
  color: var(--bs-body-color);
}

/* Program chair students module (.pcs-app) */
html[data-bs-theme="dark"] .pcs-app {
  --pcs-text: #e2e8f0;
  --pcs-muted: #94a3b8;
  --pcs-border: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.12);
  color: var(--pcs-text);
}

html[data-bs-theme="dark"] .pcs-app .pcs-card {
  background: #151b24;
  border-color: var(--pcs-border);
  box-shadow: 0 4px 20px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.35);
}

html[data-bs-theme="dark"] .pcs-app .pcs-card-header {
  border-bottom-color: var(--pcs-border);
}

html[data-bs-theme="dark"] .pcs-app .pcs-field label {
  color: #cbd5e1;
}

html[data-bs-theme="dark"] .pcs-app .pcs-field label .pcs-opt {
  color: var(--pcs-muted);
}

html[data-bs-theme="dark"] .pcs-app .pcs-field input,
html[data-bs-theme="dark"] .pcs-app .pcs-field select {
  background: #0f1419;
  border-color: #334155;
  color: #e2e8f0;
}

html[data-bs-theme="dark"] .pcs-app .pcs-password-hint {
  color: var(--pcs-muted);
}

html[data-bs-theme="dark"] .pcs-app .pcs-btn-secondary {
  background: #1e293b;
  border-color: #475569;
  color: #e2e8f0;
}

html[data-bs-theme="dark"] .pcs-app .pcs-btn-secondary:hover {
  background: #334155;
  border-color: #64748b;
  color: #f8fafc;
}

html[data-bs-theme="dark"] .pcs-app .pcs-btn-outline {
  border-color: #475569;
  color: #e2e8f0;
}

html[data-bs-theme="dark"] .pcs-app .pcs-btn-outline:hover {
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.06);
  color: #f8fafc;
}

html[data-bs-theme="dark"] .pcs-app .pcs-college-badge {
  background: #1e293b;
  color: #e2e8f0;
  border-color: var(--pcs-border);
}

html[data-bs-theme="dark"] .pcs-app .pcs-nav-tabs {
  border-bottom-color: var(--pcs-border);
}

html[data-bs-theme="dark"] .pcs-app .pcs-nav-tab {
  color: #94a3b8;
}

html[data-bs-theme="dark"] .pcs-app .pcs-nav-tab:hover {
  color: #93c5fd;
  background: rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.12);
}

html[data-bs-theme="dark"] .pcs-app .pcs-nav-tab.pcs-active {
  color: #93c5fd;
  border-bottom-color: #3b82f6;
  background: rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.12);
}

html[data-bs-theme="dark"] .pcs-app .pcs-batch-zone,
html[data-bs-theme="dark"] .pcs-app .pcs-batch-inner {
  background: rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.6);
}

html[data-bs-theme="dark"] .pcs-app .pcs-fake-file {
  background: #1e293b;
  color: #cbd5e1;
  border-color: #475569;
}

html[data-bs-theme="dark"] .pcs-app .pcs-table th {
  background: #1e293b;
  color: #cbd5e1;

/* Classroom header banner (Google Classroom–style) */
.classroom-banner {
  --classroom-banner-image: none;
  position: relative;
  min-height: 11.5rem;
  border-radius: 0.85rem;
  overflow: hidden;
  color: #fff;
  background:
    linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(15, 76, 58, 0.92) 0%, rgba(31, 111, 67, 0.88) 45%, rgba(12, 74, 110, 0.9) 100%),
    var(--classroom-banner-image);
  background-size: cover;
  background-position: center;
  box-shadow: 0 0.35rem 1.25rem rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.12);
}

.classroom-banner.has-photo {
  background-image:
    linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.15) 0%, rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.72) 100%),
    var(--classroom-banner-image);
}

.classroom-banner__overlay {
  position: relative;
  z-index: 1;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  justify-content: flex-end;
  min-height: 11.5rem;
  padding: 1.25rem 1.35rem 1.15rem;
}

.classroom-banner__title {
  margin: 0;
  font-size: clamp(1.35rem, 2.4vw, 1.85rem);
  font-weight: 700;
  line-height: 1.25;
  letter-spacing: -0.02em;
  text-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.35);
}

.classroom-banner__meta {
  margin-top: 0.4rem;
  font-size: 0.95rem;
  opacity: 0.95;
  text-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3);
}

.classroom-banner__sep {
  margin: 0 0.4rem;
  opacity: 0.7;
}

.classroom-banner__live-note {
  margin-top: 0.45rem;
  font-size: 0.875rem;
  font-weight: 600;
  color: #fecaca;
}

.classroom-banner__actions {
  position: absolute;
  top: 0.85rem;
  right: 0.85rem;
  z-index: 2;
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 0.4rem;
  justify-content: flex-end;
}

.classroom-banner__upload-btn {

  box-shadow: 0 0.15rem 0.5rem rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.2);
}

.classroom-banner--preview {
  min-height: 8.5rem;
  max-width: 42rem;
}

.classroom-banner--preview .classroom-banner__overlay {
  min-height: 8.5rem;
  padding: 1rem 1.1rem;
}

.classroom-banner--preview .classroom-banner__title {
  font-size: 1.2rem;
}

.student-page-header--below-banner {
  margin-top: 0.25rem;
}

@media (max-width: 767.98px) {

    min-height: 9.5rem;
  }

  }

(function () {
    'use strict';

    function ready(fn) {
        if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
            document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', fn);
        } else {
            fn();
        }
    }

    ready(function () {
        var panel = document.getElementById('adminNavOffcanvas');
        var openBtn = document.getElementById('adminNavOpenBtn');
        if (!panel) {
            return;
        }

        var backdrop = null;

        function ensureBackdrop() {
            if (backdrop) {
                return backdrop;
            }
            backdrop = document.createElement('div');
            backdrop.className = 'admin-offcanvas-backdrop no-print';
            document.body.appendChild(backdrop);
            backdrop.addEventListener('click', closePanel);
            return backdrop;
        }

        function openPanel() {
            ensureBackdrop();
            // Force a reflow so the transition runs from the off-screen state.
            void panel.offsetWidth;
            panel.classList.add('show');
            panel.removeAttribute('aria-hidden');
            backdrop.classList.add('show');
            document.body.classList.add('admin-offcanvas-open', 'overflow-hidden');
            if (openBtn) {
                openBtn.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'true');
            }
        }

        function closePanel() {
            panel.classList.remove('show');
            panel.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');
            if (backdrop) {
                backdrop.classList.remove('show');
            }
            document.body.classList.remove('admin-offcanvas-open', 'overflow-hidden');
            if (openBtn) {
                openBtn.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
            }
        }

        function togglePanel() {
            if (panel.classList.contains('show')) {
                closePanel();
            } else {
                openPanel();
            }
        }

        if (openBtn) {
            openBtn.addEventListener('click', function (event) {
                event.preventDefault();
                event.stopPropagation();
                togglePanel();
            });
        }

        panel.addEventListener('click', function (event) {
            if (event.target.closest('[data-offcanvas-dismiss]')) {
                closePanel();
                return;
            }
            var link = event.target.closest('.admin-nav-link, .admin-sidebar-foot-link');
            if (link && link.getAttribute('href') && link.getAttribute('href') !== '#') {
                closePanel();
            }
        });

        document.addEventListener('keydown', function (event) {
            if (event.key === 'Escape' && panel.classList.contains('show')) {
                closePanel();
            }
        });

        window.addEventListener('resize', function () {
            if (window.innerWidth >= 992 && panel.classList.contains('show')) {
                closePanel();
            }
        });
    });
})();

(function () {
    'use strict';

    function shellHasTooltipRole() {
        var c = document.body.classList;
        return (
            c.contains('app-shell-sidebar--student') ||
            c.contains('app-shell-sidebar--admin') ||
            c.contains('app-shell-sidebar--dean') ||
            c.contains('app-shell-sidebar--gened') ||
            c.contains('app-shell-sidebar--faculty')
        );
    }

    if (!shellHasTooltipRole()) {
        return;
    }

    var DELAY = 300;
    var AUTO_DISMISS = 3000;
    var tip = null;
    var timer = null;
    var dismissTimer = null;
    var hovered = null;
    var lastX = 0;
    var lastY = 0;

    function getTip() {
        if (!tip) {
            tip = document.createElement('div');
            tip.id = 'app-cursor-tooltip';
            tip.className = 'app-cursor-tooltip';
            tip.setAttribute('role', 'tooltip');
            tip.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');
            document.body.appendChild(tip);
            tip.style.display = 'none';
        }
        return tip;
    }

    function place() {
        var el = getTip();
        if (el.style.display === 'none' || el.style.display === '') {
            return;
        }
        var pad = 14;
        var m = 10;
        el.style.left = '0px';
        el.style.top = '0px';
        el.style.visibility = 'hidden';
        el.style.display = 'block';
        var w = el.offsetWidth;
        var h = el.offsetHeight;
        var left = lastX + pad;
        var top = lastY + pad;
        if (left + w > window.innerWidth - m) {
            left = Math.max(m, window.innerWidth - w - m);
        }
        if (top + h > window.innerHeight - m) {
            top = Math.max(m, window.innerHeight - h - m);
        }
        el.style.left = left + 'px';
        el.style.top = top + 'px';
        el.style.visibility = 'visible';
    }

    function hideTip() {
        if (tip) {
            tip.style.display = 'none';
            tip.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');
        }
        if (dismissTimer) {
            clearTimeout(dismissTimer);
            dismissTimer = null;
        }
    }

    function showTip(text) {
        var node = getTip();
        node.textContent = text;
        node.style.display = 'block';
        node.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'false');
        place();
        requestAnimationFrame(place);

        if (dismissTimer) {
            clearTimeout(dismissTimer);
        }
        dismissTimer = setTimeout(hideTip, AUTO_DISMISS);
    }

    document.addEventListener(
        'mouseover',
        function (e) {
            var el = e.target.closest('[data-app-tooltip]');
            if (!el) {
                return;
            }
            if (hovered === el) {
                return;
            }
            hovered = el;
            if (timer) {
                clearTimeout(timer);
                timer = null;
            }
            lastX = e.clientX;
            lastY = e.clientY;
            timer = setTimeout(function () {
                timer = null;
                if (hovered !== el) {
                    return;
                }
                var text = el.getAttribute('data-app-tooltip');
                if (!text) {
                    return;
                }
                showTip(text);
            }, DELAY);
        },
        true
    );

    document.addEventListener(
        'mousemove',
        function (e) {
            lastX = e.clientX;
            lastY = e.clientY;
            if (!tip || tip.style.display === 'none') {
                return;
            }
            place();
        },
        true
    );

    document.addEventListener(
        'mouseout',
        function (e) {
            var el = e.target.closest('[data-app-tooltip]');
            if (!el) {
                return;
            }
            var rel = e.relatedTarget;
            if (rel && el.contains(rel)) {
                return;
            }
            if (hovered === el) {
                hovered = null;
            }
            if (timer) {
                clearTimeout(timer);
                timer = null;
            }
            hideTip();
        },
        true
    );

    document.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
        var el = e.target.closest('[data-app-tooltip]');
        if (el) {
            hideTip();
            hovered = null;
        }
    }, true);

    document.addEventListener('scroll', hideTip, true);
})();
